summary: Iteration 51: Image Crop Bug Fix Verification - PASSED. The bug where 'Apply Crop' on existing/uploaded product photos got stuck in infinite 'Processing...' state has been fixed. All crop functionality tests passed: (1) Apply Crop on existing remote image completed in 3 seconds, (2) Skip Crop button works correctly, (3) New image upload with crop works (regression test passed in 2 seconds).
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED FIX: ImageCropModal.jsx createCroppedImage function now correctly handles remote images by fetching them as blob URLs first (toSafeSrc function)
VERIFIED FIX: onerror handler added to image.onload to properly reject promise on load failure
VERIFIED FIX: try-catch block around canvas.toBlob handles any canvas errors gracefully
The fix addresses CORS/tainted canvas issues that caused the infinite Processing state
seed_data_creation: None - used existing product 'Puff Sleeve Co-Ord' with images
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image crop functionality is now fully working. The bug was in createCroppedImage which used crossOrigin='anonymous' and had no onerror/reject path, causing Promise to hang forever when loading remote image URLs. Fix: fetch remote URL as blob first (toSafeSrc), removed crossOrigin, added onerror handler that rejects, wrapped toBlob in try-catch.

apply_crop_existing_image.details: Clicked crop icon on existing product image, adjusted zoom, clicked Apply Crop - completed in 3 seconds without getting stuck

skip_crop_button.details: Skip Crop button closes modal immediately without errors

new_image_upload_with_crop.details: Uploaded new test image, crop modal opened, Apply Crop completed in 2 seconds - regression test passed

crop_modal_ui.details: Modal opens correctly with image loaded in cropper, zoom slider works, rotate button visible

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: After clicking 'Apply Crop' on existing/uploaded product photo, it gets stuck in infinite 'Processing...' state
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: createCroppedImage used crossOrigin='anonymous' and had no onerror/reject path, causing Promise to hang forever when loading remote image URLs due to CORS/tainted canvas issues
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: toSafeSrc function fetches remote images as blob URLs first, onerror handler rejects promise on failure, try-catch around toBlob
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: FIXED - Apply Crop now completes in 2-3 seconds for both existing and new images
